channel.title: API Workbench — Changelog
channel.description: Release notes and milestones for API Workbench.

item.title: Phase 16 — Plugin SDK
item.description: Plugin loader, extension registries, sandboxed plugin host, and capability broker. Custom workflow nodes, request types, auth providers, and importers.

item.title: Multi-protocol execution — GraphQL, gRPC, WebSocket, SSE
item.description: Protocol-agnostic execution envelope with GraphQL, gRPC, WebSocket, and SSE support in the runner and workflows, including live interactive sessions.

item.title: Phases 12–15 — Workflow engine, designer, runtime, and mapping
item.description: Visual drag-and-drop workflow designer with deterministic runtime, conditions, loops, retries, pause/resume, and JSONPath/JMESPath data mapping.
